messages:
Maya: Heads up — pricing change goes live next Wednesday (2026-04-01) for new packaging tiers. We need final alignment on metering -> billing pipeline, quota enforcement, and contract mapping. Who owns the end-to-end? I'm listing blockers below. @jason @devon @rohan @emily

Jason: I can own runtime side (metering/events + router enforcement) but need to confirm whether quotas are soft (logging only) or hard (reject).

Devon: Billing will expect accurate token events by 00:05 UTC daily. We aggregate by customer_id + tier. We need guarantee of no double-counting during retries. Also contract team needs to map min_commitments -> billing SKU id.

Rohan: On contracts: current template has a 'min_monthly_commitment' clause that doesn't neatly map to per-token quotas. Need to decide: map to monthly spend target (preferred) or to token quota buckets. Prefer spend target to match legal wording.

Emily: SRE: rate-limiter lives in routing layer. If quotas are hard we need fallback policies and circuit breakers. Can we get acceptance testing steps?

Jason: Proposal: keep metering event stream authoritative for billing. Router enforces soft quotas (warning headers) for first rollout, then hard rejects on canary + opt-in customers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/482 - adds meter-proxy and warning headers. @devon can you confirm billing can consume warning headers for reconciliation?

Devon: We won't consume warning headers; billing needs authoritative events. But we can use warning headers to flag customers in billing dashboard. Main ask: include a unique event_id per token batch to dedupe. Example event payload:
```
{ "event_id": "uuid", "customer_id": "c_123", "tokens": 1234, "model": "gptx-4", "timestamp": "2026-04-01T12:00:00Z" }
```

Rohan: Also need to update contract mapping doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/contracts/pricing-mapping — I'll add proposed clause to prefer spend-based commitments. Can someone own the crosswalk matrix?

Maya: I'll own the crosswalk doc and deadline: COB Tuesday. Deliverable: mapping table + list of customers needing manual adjustments.

Jason: :+1: I'll merge the PR by EOD Monday if we get token dedupe logic in place. Quick question — where does quota enforcement sit? router or serving runtime?

Emily: Serving runtime should enforce short-window rate limits (per-second). Router handles per-customer daily quota checks (reads quota cache + issues warnings/rejects). Need TTL for cache updates. I'll add a config: quota_cache_ttl=30s.

Devon: Billing can accept deduped events. We also need to surface refunds/adjustments from contract exceptions. Put a hook in event schema: "adjustment_reason" optional.

Jason: Noted. I'll update schema and add unit tests. Tagging code-review: @emily @devon please review when ready.

billing-bot: TICKET-8912 created: 'Metering dedupe & event schema for pricing rollout' — assignee: devon, due: 2026-03-30.

Maya: Thanks all. Next steps: Jason implement dedupe + PR, Devon onboard billing consumer and confirm edge cases, Rohan update contracts page, Emily define enforcement config. Ping me when each is done. :eyes:
